surgery is an absolute joke. I have twice had to make formal complaints to the surgery and their response was "You should ensure you use the same GP foe each appointment so they understand your history" - It is hard enough to get an appointment with any GP nevermind the same one each time!
My first complaint was due to me attending the practice 3 times due to abdominal pain, the first doctor made me take a pregnancy test and took some bloods, the second said I had trapped wind and prescribed me coedine for the pain, the third said I just have to deal with it. A few days later I ended up in A&E as my inflammation markers were through the roof, prepped for surgery and diagnosed with ulcerative colitis. Turns out they never checked the blood tests they'd done or they would have seen my inflammation markers were high and the drugs they prescribed made me worse. Luckily I responded to the correct medication in hospital, was in over a week before being discharged and didn't have surgery. This just shows how dismissive they are with patients, they don't listen, don't check their records correctly and just shove you out the door with something to manage the symptoms rather than dealing with the underlying issue.
My second complaint, I booked a smear test in 2023 as I was having some pains, I attended to be told I can't have it as I haven't had a letter to say I need one. I checked my records and my last smear was 2018, they're supposed to be every 3 years. I left it as I couldn't be bothered with the back and forth. I got a letter in 2024 and attended the smear which came back as abnormal, I complained and said I knew it would be abnormal as I had pain in the previous year but no one would actually do the smear. I had to go to hospital and have cells removed. If this had been left any longer it could have developed into cervical cancer. Again showing that the surgery do not listen to patients. Surely if someone is asking for a smear due to pain it should be completed without any questions not sent away because you don't have a 'letter'.
They recently deleted all of my repeat medication because I needed to go in for an annual check up. This meant I couldn't order any of my prescriptions including my inhaler which is potentially life saving and my medication to treat my ulcerative colitis.
To say this surgery is underperforming would be a huge understatement, they have made so many errors in my treatment that have had the potential to be life threatening. They will be the cause of many deaths due to them not listening, not acting and being very dismissive of patients symptoms. I have now left the surgery and I will never be
